newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent futures edge up in thin market.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent futures edge up in thin market.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures edged higher late on Thursday in a quiet market following the overnight plunge on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE), brokers said.
They said players were unsure about market directions but they saw support at $21.80, with resistance around $22.50.
IPE plunged $1.13 to close at $22.15, one of the biggest single day fall in recent months after breaking two key support levels of $22.49 and $22.38.

SIMEX for January last traded at $22.45 a barrel, 30 cents over the last IPE close, with 31 lots recorded at 0956 GMT. February was more actively traded, registering 70 lots at 0630 GMT when it last traded at $21.77, up 13 cents from its previous IOPE close.
NYMEX January crude on the after-hours ACCESS rose 22 cents over its last official close to trade at $23.62.
